spreadsheet_metadata_cleanup.purpose: Remove personal information and non-English text from Excel document properties and formatting metadata before public release. Cell values and text are unchanged.
changes: docProps/core.xml: removed the creator and last-modified-by names.
docProps/app.xml: Excel part headings set to the English labels 'Worksheets' and 'Named Ranges'.
xl/workbook.xml: removed the last local save folder (x15ac:absPath); Excel regenerates it on save.

xl/styles.xml, xl/theme/theme1.xml, xl/sharedStrings.xml: localized font names replaced by the English names of the same fonts (DengXian, DengXian Light, Malgun Gothic, PMingLiU); built-in 'Normal' cell-style name written in English. In xl/sharedStrings.xml only rich-text run font names changed.
